title: Deep in the Green
blurb: Finn and Zeb trek into the misty mountains to count a gorilla family.
cover_prompt: Finn and Zeb in khaki explorer outfits and green safari hats stand heroically on a misty green mountain trail, Zeb holding up his camera and Finn holding a map, with a big gentle silverback gorilla and a baby gorilla sitting peacefully in the lush plants behind them and a green jeep on the track.

sound.label: /ee/
sound.intro: Listen for the /ee/ sound, as in deep. In this story it is spelt three ways. Tap a word to hear it.

cracked: Four gorillas, safe and well, counted and photographed. Finn and Zeb cracked the case!

text: Finn and Zeb are in the Den. Ping!
A ranger needs them to count gorillas.
p1.prompt: Inside the cosy explorer den, the wall screen shows a friendly park ranger in a green uniform waving from a misty mountain forest, with a gorilla silhouette and a flashing alert; Finn grabs his explorer hat, Zeb grabs a camera.

text: They fly to the misty green hills.
Zeb has the camera. Finn has the map.
p2.prompt: A small yellow plane flies over rolling misty green mountains and forests; Finn and Zeb look out of the window, Finn holding a folded map, Zeb holding a camera on a strap, both in khaki explorer outfits with green safari hats.

text: A jeep bumps up the steep, steep track.
The trees drip. Monkeys peep at them.
p3.prompt: An open green jeep bumps up a steep muddy mountain track through dripping rainforest trees; Finn and Zeb bounce in the back seats holding their safari hats on, while curious monkeys peep out from the branches above.

text: Keep seven big steps back, says the ranger.
Gorillas can catch our sneezes. Achoo!
p4.prompt: A friendly park ranger in a green uniform crouches to talk to Finn and Zeb at the edge of a misty forest, holding up seven fingers; Zeb is mid-sneeze with his hands over his nose, Finn laughing; a trail leads into the dense green.

text: Finn sees a nest of leaves and a trail
of bent plants. Which way, Finn?
c1.prompt: In a lush misty mountain forest, Finn and Zeb stand where the path splits: on one side a big round nest of flattened leaves on the ground, on the other side a trail of bent and trampled plants leading into the green; Finn points one way, Zeb the other.

text: The nest is a heap of leaves.
A gorilla slept here. It is still warm!
b1a.prompt: Finn and Zeb crouch beside a big round nest of leaves and branches on the forest floor; Finn holds his hand over it feeling the warmth, Zeb peeks in with wide eyes; a few black hairs on the leaves, misty forest around.

text: They creep along the trail of bent plants.
Chewed stems. Green poo! They are near.
b1b.prompt: Finn and Zeb creep on tiptoe along a trail of bent and trampled plants in the misty forest; Finn points at chewed green stems, Zeb holds his nose and points at a pile of green gorilla poo, both grinning.

text: Then they see them. A big silverback sits
in the green, eating leaves. Munch, munch.
p5.prompt: A huge gentle silverback mountain gorilla with a silver back sits calmly in lush green plants munching a leafy stem; Finn and Zeb peek from behind ferns a good distance away, the ranger behind them, everyone quiet and amazed.

text: Two mums and a baby. Finn counts: four!
Zeb clicks the camera. Click, click.
p6.prompt: A mountain gorilla family in a sunny clearing: one silverback, two mother gorillas and one tiny baby gorilla in a row; Finn counts on his fingers holding up five, Zeb takes a photo with his camera from behind a log.

text: The silverback stands and beats his chest.
Pok, pok, pok! It means: this is my team.
p7.prompt: The big silverback gorilla stands tall on two legs and beats his chest with cupped hands, mouth open in a hoot, while his family watches calmly behind him; Finn and Zeb watch wide-eyed and smiling from a safe distance behind a fallen log.

text: The baby creeps up to Zeb. It wants to
see the camera! What should they do?

reveal.text: Rangers say: step back, because gorillas can catch our germs. But a baby that comes to you is hard to stop! Rangers find it tricky too. What would you do?

c2.prompt: A tiny curious baby mountain gorilla has crept right up to Zeb and reaches a little hand towards the camera hanging on his chest; Zeb stands frozen with a nervous grin, Finn holds up his hands unsure; the mother gorilla watches from the green behind.

text: They keep as still as trees. The baby peeks
at Zeb, then sneezes! Mum leads it back.
b2a.prompt: Finn and Zeb stand as still as statues with silly stiff faces while the tiny baby gorilla peeks up at Zeb and does a big sneeze; the mother gorilla ambles over to lead it gently back by the hand.

text: They step back, step by step. The baby
squeaks, then bumps back to its mum.
b2b.prompt: Finn and Zeb step backwards slowly and carefully along the forest path, Finn holding Zeb's hand; the tiny baby gorilla squeaks and bumbles back across the clearing to its mother's open arms.

text: Finn holds the camera up high. The baby
sees itself! It beats its tiny chest.
b2c.prompt: Finn holds the camera up high so its screen shows the baby gorilla its own face; the tiny baby gorilla stands up and beats its little chest proudly, Zeb giggles, the mother gorilla watches with a soft smile.

text: The ranger grins. Four gorillas, safe and
well. Finn adds them to the count sheet.
p8.prompt: The park ranger kneels beside Finn, who writes on a clipboard count sheet showing four gorilla drawings with ticks; Zeb shows the camera screen with a gorilla photo; the gorilla family rests peacefully in the green behind.

text: Rain begins to fall. The jeep is far.
Which way back, Finn?
c3.prompt: Rain starts to pour in the misty mountain forest; Finn and Zeb hold their safari hats, looking down a long steep muddy track to the tiny green jeep far below, and at a clump of enormous umbrella-sized leaves beside them.

text: They run! Feet slide. Zeb cheers.
They reach the jeep, wet but happy.
b3a.prompt: Finn and Zeb run and slide down the muddy rainforest track in the pouring rain, Zeb cheering with arms up, Finn laughing, mud splashing, the green jeep waiting at the bottom with the ranger holding an umbrella.

text: They sit under huge leaves. Drip, drip.
Zeb sees a beetle. Then the rain stops.
b3b.prompt: Finn and Zeb sit snugly under an enormous green leaf like an umbrella as rain drips off its edges; Zeb points delightedly at a shiny rainbow-coloured beetle on a stem; sunshine beginning to break through the mist.

text: Back in the Den, the photos go up on
the screen. Four gorillas! Case cracked!
p9.prompt: Back in the cosy explorer den, the big wall screen shows Zeb's photos of the gorilla family with a big green tick; Zeb stands proudly with his camera, Finn pins the count sheet to the corkboard.

casefile.title: Mountain gorilla
casefile.subtitle: Big and strong, but gentle.

facts.text: A silverback can weigh 180 kg. That is as heavy as two grown-ups.
A gorilla can eat 34 kg of plants in one day, about as heavy as Finn and Zeb together.
There are only about 1,000 mountain gorillas. Rangers count them to keep them safe.

casefile.prompt: A Creature Cases style fact file portrait of a mountain gorilla family: a big gentle silverback sitting among lush green mountain plants with a mother and a tiny baby gorilla, misty peaks behind; clean, bright, centred, like a collector card illustration, no text.

quiz.why: The big one with the silver back.

quiz.q: What did the silverback do with his chest?
quiz.why: It means: this is my team.

quiz.q: Why did the ranger say to keep seven big steps back?
quiz.why: Our germs can make them ill.

quiz.q: Why does Finn count the gorillas?
quiz.why: Rangers count them so they know the family is safe and well.

debrief.question: Would you keep still or step back if the baby came to you? Why?
